translations.web: For the ways of man are before Yahweh’s eyes. He examines all his paths.
translations.bsb: For a man’s ways are before the eyes of the LORD, and the LORD examines all his paths.
translations.kjv: For the ways of man are before the eyes of the LORD, and he pondereth all his goings.
translations.asv: For the ways of man are before the eyes of Jehovah; And he maketh level all his paths.
